observed_failure.message: A finite saveat must be an integer number of seconds.

disposition: The frozen RM13 fixture is invalid because its solver output cadence is not representable by the exact Ribasim release. This is not a physical or numerical falsification of the SWAP-MODFLOW-Ribasim composition.
preserved_claims: The physical coupling window remains 8.64 seconds.
The irrigation request remains 0.0036 cm at 36 cm/day.
The management init seam is independently qualified by the RM13 smoke gate after fixing a Fortran dummy-argument shadowing bug.
Ribasim allocation clock ownership remains governed by RM03/RM11/RM12 and is not assigned to solver.saveat.
technical_history: Initial local JuliaC build was cancelled by the GitHub runner before execution.
Official v2026.1.1 release binary was adopted with published SHA256 verification.
MODFLOW release download was authenticated after an external GitHub API rate-limit failure.
Fortran request output dummy shadowed REQUEST_DEPTH_CM case-insensitively and was corrected; independent smoke then returned exactly 0.0036 cm.
Official Ribasim release runtime directories were added to the dynamic loader path.
nonclaims: No three-model composition result is inferred from RM13.
No tolerance or physical parameter is relaxed.
No claim is made that 8.64-second finite saveat is supported.
required_successor: RM13B with the same physical window and coupling contract, but a valid non-owning Ribasim solver output cadence preregistered before execution.
